confirmed: BINGO BINGO uses an electronic random draw system and automatic computer draws.
Lottery outlet TV screens display animations and are separate from the actual electronic draw system.
Results are generated when ticket sales close; the displayed animation is not the draw.

clarification.excluded_as_inapplicable: Physical ball-set identifiers and physical ball-draw machine identifiers are not relevant candidate covariates for BINGO BINGO's documented electronic draw mechanism.
clarification.only_possible_reopen_gate: Independently verifiable, timestamped information available BEFORE each draw that plausibly describes the electronic draw system or its state, and provides sufficient chronological coverage for training and untouched out-of-sample tests.
not_accepted: Physical ball-set hypotheses borrowed from other lottery games
Post-event draw numbers or result-derived proxies
Draw-term/time indices alone without independent state evidence
Post-hoc features lacking verifiable pre-event timestamps

privacy: No raw draws, target fingerprints, detailed rankings, or wagering rationale included.
